tasks.title: internal/routing/ package — Engine + dispatch.Registry + filter matcher + Prometheus counters
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/006-routing-engine-core/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/routing-engine.feature}. SECOND: create internal/routing/engine.go with `Engine` type that (REQ-501) subscribes to the 4 MQTT topic shapes; (REQ-502) on inbound, queries the in-memory route cache filtered by (tenant, source_type, filter-match); (REQ-503) iterates matching routes invoking dispatch.Registry handlers. (REQ-513) implement filter matcher accepting JSON `{keyword?, portnum?, device_imei?}` with AND-semantics across present fields. (REQ-514/515/516) emit Prometheus counters hub_route_dispatch_success_total{destination_type} + hub_route_dispatch_error_total{reason=unknown-destination|handler-error}. (REQ-517/518) Engine.Reload() refreshes the cache within 1s; called by the API layer on every mutation. Define `Handler` interface {Dispatch(ctx, route, msg) error} + `Registry` map[string]Handler.
